name: Mucus Spray
body:
School evocation; Level sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a bit of phlegm)

EFFECT

Range 15 ft.
Area cone-shaped burst
Duration instant (daze 1 round)
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The caster sprays a fine mist of poisonous mucus. The mucus is acidic and has psychedelic properties. The mucus does 1d4 hp acid damage per caster level. In addition, a failed save leaves the targets dazed for one round.
